messages:
maria: FYI bringing up the new HF Llama-variant and ran into a weird conversion issue from the jinja chat_template -> Redwood prompt.
maria: In short: macros that render an empty assistant message end up being stripped and that removal collapses role boundaries. After quantizing the model we saw KV-cache misalignment and assistant replies with duplicate tokens.
ajay: ugh. do you have a minimal repro? can you paste the jinja fragment?
maria: here it is:
```jinja
{% macro help_section() -%}
{% if helpers %}
Assistant: {{ helpers }}
{% else %}

{%- endif %}
{%- endmacro %}

- system: "You are a helpful assistant."
- user: "Summarize this: ..."
- assistant: ""  # macro can render empty assistant block
```
maria: After our HF->Redwood conversion the assistant line gets removed completely, so the final prompt concatenates user/system tokens and the runtime interprets the next assistant response as if it were continuing previous role, which screws up kv offsets.
model-checker-bot: regression detected: token-offset-drift >= 3 on repeat-run with q4_0 quant.
sasha: did you check special tokens / role markers in config.json? some models use custom sentinel tokens for assistant.
maria: yes. config.json had "bos_token": "<s>", no explicit assistant sentinel. HF chat_template relies on structural roles, but our converter was naively trimming blank messages.
tim: can you show the converted prompt? 
maria: converted prompt (excerpt):
```text
<s> system: You are a helpful assistant.
<s> user: Summarize this: ...
<s> user: <followup instruction that used to be assistant boundary>
```
maria: see how the assistant tag is gone and user text moved up, role boundary collapsed.
olivia: that would shift the expected caching pattern. when the runtime computes KV cache chunking it assumes role delims at specific token positions.
ajay: short-term fix: when converter sees an empty assistant node, insert a zero-width placeholder token or explicit assistant sentinel, e.g. `<|assistant|>` or `` so role stays present.
sasha: or preserve an empty newline marker like `assistant: [EMPTY]` and strip for model ingest but keep for tokenizer alignment.
maria: tried adding `assistant: "<assistant/"` and reran conversion; converted prompt preserved role and the quantized run matched golden tokens. model-checker-bot then reported drift=0.
model-checker-bot: re-eval: token-offset-drift = 0 ✅
tim: can we make converter configurable? flag --preserve-empty-roles true/false
maria: I hacked a patch in rw_tools/convert_chat.py to detect macros that render nothing and inject `##ASSISTANT_EMPTY##`, then post-process to map to sentinel or remove only after tokenization. simple diff:
```diff
- if not message.strip(): skip
+ if not message.strip(): message = '##ASSISTANT_EMPTY##'
```
olivia: nice. also add a mapping table so customers with custom sentinel tokens can control the replacement via config.json.
ajay: note: watch out for Jinja filters that produce whitespace-only markup (e.g., `{{ var|trim }}`) — treat that as empty too.
sasha: we should add a unit test in eng-ml suite: create chat_template with macro-empty assistant and assert converter keeps role sentinel and quantized run matches FP baseline.
maria: filing a small RFC PR with the patch + tests. putting repro and logs in the PR.
tim: thanks — saved us from a nasty prod regression if someone onboarded this model in Dedicated. :relieved:
maria: also adding a short note to the onboarding checklist: "ensure chat_template conversion preserves empty assistant nodes or configure sentinel mapping".
olivia: can you attach the failing decode snippet and the quant logs to the PR? will help SRE/ops if we see similar drift.
maria: will do. linking to PR in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
